- Guidance for choosing parameters based on intended use (print, demo, crop, etc.).

- Initial release of p-image-upscale skill for AI-powered image upscaling.
- Supports configurable target resolution (1–128 megapixels), detail enhancement, and output format options.
- Provides detailed usage guidelines, including best practices for print, crops, and quality demo workflows.
- Recommends user input confirmation for scaling parameters and offers advice for when/when not to use upscaling in video workflows.
- Includes sample API calls and integration notes for further image editing or comparison demos.
